question: Nirbhay missile has a strike range of:
solution:
The correct answer is **1000 km**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Nirbhay missile** is an Indian long-range, all-weather, subsonic cruise missile.
 
• It has a **strike range** of approximately **1000 km**, making it capable of hitting targets at a considerable distance.
 
• Developed by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** of India, it is designed to carry both conventional and nuclear warheads.
 
• The missile can be launched from multiple platforms, including **land, sea, and air**.
 
• It features a **terrain-hugging capability** to avoid detection and improve survivability.
